ana (docs-i18n): Heads-up: launching translated quickstarts (es/pt/fr) into a new "Recipes - Localized" section. Also a small SDK payload change for embeddings: field `engine` will be renamed to `embed_model`. Noting here for visibility and rollout coordination. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1502

jin (sdk): Thanks. Short impact note: embeddings API call changes param name only. Ordinary callers will need a 1-line update. SDKs will publish a compat shim for two releases.

rohit (devex): I'll prepare migration snippets for JS/Python + a tiny sed script folks can run. Will also add a docs code block for the new param.

elaine (product): Timeline? We want translations live before next marketing campaign. Can docs flip coincide with SDK patch?

ana?? (typo)
diego (support): Please add a KB entry and quick repro steps for 400s. I'll pre-populate canned replies for top accounts.

translations-bot: Translation bundles uploaded: es, pt-BR, fr. Preview links: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/recipes/localized/:eyes: 

ana (fix): lol ignore my typo earlier.

jin (sdk): Example change for reference — old vs new: 
```js
// OLD
await client.embeddings({ engine: "text-embedding-3-small", input: "search term" })
// NEW
await client.embeddings({ embed_model: "text-embedding-3-small", input: "search term" })
```

rohit (devex): I'll add a small compatibility script `ci/replace-embed-field.sh` to the docs repo and link it in the migration guide. Also will add a redirect map from old quickstart URLs to the localized recipes for 30 days.

jin (sdk): Plan: publish patch SDKs with a runtime shim that accepts both `engine` and `embed_model` for 2 releases, then remove shim. I'll open PRs today.

ci-bot: Docs preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/1502 (:rocket:)

deploy-bot: Canary flip scheduled: 2026-06-18 14:00 UTC (window 45m)

elaine (product): Ok target: translations + docs flip 6/18. SDK shim published 6/17. Marketing copy will point to localized recipes.

diego (support): Deprecation window? We need explicit dates for customers.

ana (docs-i18n): Deprecation policy: 45 days after full flip we'll stop accepting `engine` at the API surface. We'll add a banner, changelog, and an API-level 410 note after 60 days.
